answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The ivory holds work receipts rather than names, so the ocean of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the yarrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
